name: Culture & Tradition
blurb: Three cue cards. A small cluster, but one where specific Vietnamese detail is easy to make vivid.

items: What do you think of Vietnamese traditional music?
Do you think it is necessary for children to have music classes?
Do you like art?
Is there any artwork on the wall in your room?
What is your favourite cuisine?
What kinds of meals do you like?
Do you often have dinner with your family?
Do you like learning history?
Do you think we should keep old buildings in cities?
Did you learn about the history of your hometown at school?

p2.t: Describe a food that people eat on special occasions or events
b: How it is cooked or made
And explain why people eat it on that occasion

p2.t: Describe a special cake you received from others
b: Who you got the cake from
And explain why it is a special cake

p2.t: Describe a new law you would like to introduce in your country
b: Whether the new law will be popular
And explain how you feel about this new law

items: What are the differences between special food in Vietnam and in other countries?
Do people usually cook special food in Vietnam?
Should special food be easily available?
Which food is generally popular in your country?
Is traditional craftsmanship important to a country's industry?
What can handmade products bring to tourist attractions?
Do you think handmade is a good thing?
Do you think rules are important?
What is the purpose of punishment?
How can parents help children understand and follow rules?
What rules should people obey at work?
